title: A Canon of Blood and Life United
summary: A canon for the dual-stream cultivator who joins the blood and the growth of life into one flow that mends and raises as readily as it strikes.

title: The Treatise of Blood Meeting Death
summary: A treatise for the dual-stream cultivator who sets the stream of blood against the stream of ending and finds the edge where a life slips out.

title: A Manual of the Blood-Soul Bond
summary: A manual for the dual-stream cultivator with a formed Core who binds the pulse of the body to the pulse of the soul and strikes through both.
